title: Oxva Slim Stick Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Created for the Oxva Slim Stick Prefilled Pod Kit, these Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Prefilled Pods deliver a layered berry flavour in a hassle-free format. Each 2ml pod contains 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and provides up to 600 puffs depending on use. The flavour blends the sweetness of ripe Strawberries with the tangy bite of Raspberry and the deeper juiciness of Cherry. The combination creates a rounded, mixed-berry taste that’s both fruity and satisfying from start to finish. Built-in coils ensure reliable vapour and flavour output, while the closed design makes swapping pods quick and mess-free. With their smooth mouth-to-lung draw, these pods arrive in a pack of two and slot easily into the Slim Stick device for straightforward berry-inspired vaping.
